body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy crosses a visible gap of at least 1 unit between cover sources. Response: After that movement, on success deal 1 weapon Damage and make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: If hit and Locked, end Lock to impose -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.
